description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Alpha Omega is an award-winning solutions provider delivering mission-enabling technology and strategic solutions for government customers. The company is seeking a Javascript Developer to support a long-term Federal project by developing JavaScript/TypeScript applications, collaborating in an agile team, using Azure DevOps and Git, and creating front-end tests.
JavaScript/TypeScript developer building React and Node applications with unit and end-to-end testing

Responsibilities:
• Typically required to work as a team member under the direction of senior personnel utilizing an agile methodology
• Peer program alongside mid-level and senior developers in JavaScript/Typescript, node, NestJS, and React tech stack
• Utilize Azure DevOps and Git repositories
• Develop end-to-end and unit tests for front end functionality

Requirements:
• 1-2 years of related work experience with progressively increasing responsibility
• Experience with UI/UX design implementation
• Knowledge of working in a demanding agile environment, responding to client requests, and working with inside and outside stakeholders
• Familiarity with API/Data-driven web applications
• Excellent interpersonal skills, as well as excellent communication skills, verbal and written to both technical and non-technical audiences through remote communication tools
• Initiative to recommend process improvements and demonstrate creative thinking
• BA/BS in Information Systems Management, Computer Science or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience
• US Citizen, Public Trust

Preferred:
• Experience with RESTful API design and development preferred
• Experience with Azure DevOps preferred
